emily: Quick heads up — during the rehearsal we hit a GOP encoder spike on stream-prod-01. Seeing ~3s chunk delays. Can ops do a quick rollback to encoder v2 while we confirm the agenda order?
noah: on it, checking logs now. where's the runbook for the encoder rollback? :eyes:
kate: tagging the agenda — we should swap the Q&A to after the roadmap so we don't cut off questions if we need to debug. ok with leadership? @lia?
lia: yea that's fine. leadership, is that okay? we can slide the roadmap to 10:20 and move Q&A to 10:45.
sanjay: rollback approved. emily, if we move Q&A later pls ping me — I need to make sure the demo isn't mid-rollout.
noah: log snippet: ```ERR encode_timeout: 120s
stream-prod-01 /encoder/v3/ compile_failed: kernel mismatch```
noah: running rollback script now: ```/scripts/infra/rollback_encoder --service stream-prod-01 --to v2.9.1```
deploy-bot: deploy starting: rollback job id 98765 for stream-prod-01 (initiated by noah) :hourglass:  
emily: thanks — I'll announce the agenda swap in 1min and ask people to hold Qs until after roadmap.
kate: tiny request — can we timebox leadership Q&A to 20m if we're still debugging? we hate running over.
lia: yes, 20m max. if more follow-ups, we'll collect in the follow-up doc and Triage with PMs.
noah: rollback complete, encoder back to v2.9.1. latency looks stable: 120ms P95 now. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: rollback job id 98765 completed in 48s
emily: sweet — stream is green. Updated agenda posted in #calendar and I pinned it to the all-hands doc. I'll open with the quick note about the swap.
sanjay: quick prod note for anyone running demos: avoid starting a new canary deploy during the Q&A window 10:45-11:05 — ops will whiteboard if we need an emergency patch.
kate: adding postmortem owner for encoder spike: @noah. please add initial timeline to the incidents doc later today.
emily: final reminder to speakers: stick to slide limits (3 minutes each) to keep the Q&A slot healthy. I'll post a timer command in the briefing channel.
noah: ping if latency creeps again, I'll keep an eye on stream-prod-01.
emily: thanks everyone — see you on set in 10. :microphone:
